meta.tagline: Front-end developer & WordPress specialist — 20+ years hand-coding sites that convert
meta.description: Hand-coded website rebuilds, new builds, e-commerce cart/theme upgrades, WordPress care, and AI-augmented delivery from a 20+ year front-end developer and WordPress specialist.
meta.author: CM Web Development

services.title: Website Rebuilds
services.summary: A rebuild of the site you already have — same business, same brand, but a storefront or homepage that finally works. Dated, cluttered, or barely-usable sites rebuilt around real hierarchy and the product photography or content that was already there.
services.forWho: Businesses whose current site is quietly costing them customers — a crowded header, a hero that doesn't sell anything, navigation buyers can't get through, or a layout that breaks on a phone.
bullets: Replace crowded, multi-row headers with a single clean bar — logo, search, account, cart.
Rebuild the hero around real product photography or content instead of stock images and text stacked on top.
Cut bloated navigation down to the categories customers actually use, so they reach a product in fewer clicks.
Make the whole site properly responsive — many of the sites I've rebuilt were barely usable on a phone before.
Work across WordPress, PinnacleCart, and hand-coded HTML/CSS storefronts — whatever platform the business is already running.

services.title: New Builds
services.summary: A new site or storefront built from scratch — hand-coded, semantic HTML/CSS translated from a mockup into a responsive, pixel-accurate live build. No page-builder bloat, no framework overhead.
services.forWho: New businesses or product lines that need a site that doesn't exist yet — a storefront, a content hub, or a marketing site.
bullets: Hand-code semantic HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap to translate a mockup into a responsive, pixel-accurate site.
Optimize CSS to cut file size and eliminate render-blocking resources instead of shipping a framework's full stylesheet.
Set up hosting, domains, and email as part of the build, not as an afterthought.
Built new storefronts and content hubs on the PinnacleCart platform, from mockup to live build.

services.title: App & Product Work
services.summary: Application work beyond the brochure site — internal tools, dashboards, and product front-ends built in React (Vite + TypeScript) with Node.js or Python behind them. Delivered through the same AI-augmented pipeline as the site work, with compile checks and visual-parity QA on every build rather than a hand-off and hope.
services.forWho: Businesses who need something a CMS page can't do — a tool their team uses daily, a customer-facing dashboard, or a product front-end that has to hold up under real use.
bullets: Build product front-ends and internal tools in React with Vite and TypeScript, typed end to end.
Back them with Node.js or Python services, scoped to what the tool actually needs rather than a stack chosen in advance.
Run the same delivery pipeline as the site work: compile checks on every build and visual-parity QA before anything ships.
Carry the same accessibility and responsive floor the sites get — keyboard paths, reduced-motion support, and layouts that hold on a phone.
Hand over readable, commented source you or another developer can pick up — no framework lock-in beyond what the job needs.

services.title: E-Commerce & Cart Upgrades
services.summary: Cart and theme upgrades for merchants who are stuck on an old storefront template — re-themed onto the current, mobile-responsive version of their platform without losing catalog, customers, or traffic. Also full e-commerce store builds on Shopify and PinnacleCart.
services.forWho: Merchants on PinnacleCart or Shopify running a legacy theme that's falling behind — slow, non-responsive, or missing current cart features.
bullets: Re-theme and upgrade live merchant storefronts to the latest cart version — migrating off legacy themes onto current, mobile-responsive templates.
Migrate a live store without losing catalog, customers, or traffic in the process.
Designed and built a Shopify e-commerce store end to end — hosting, domains, email, product catalog, and Facebook Shops integration.
Redesign conversion-focused storefronts across industrial supply, e-commerce, and retail merchants.

services.title: WordPress Care & Maintenance
services.summary: Ongoing management of a WordPress site or portfolio of sites on WP Engine — updates, backups, security, and uptime/performance monitoring — so the site stays fast and safe without the owner having to think about it.
services.forWho: Businesses and agencies running WordPress who need reliable day-to-day care, not a one-off project.
bullets: Manage a portfolio of client WordPress sites end to end — maintenance, plugin/theme updates, backups, security, and uptime/performance monitoring on WP Engine.
Build, add, and update pages across sites (Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg block themes), keeping every change on-brand and content-accurate.
Run migrations and backup/restore drills with minimal disruption to live traffic.
Support SEO, PPC, and content campaigns on the dev side — conversion landing pages, on-page SEO, and blog publishing through a staged dev-review to production workflow.

services.title: AI-Augmented Delivery
services.summary: "Devy," a multi-agent AI development system built on Claude Code, orchestrating specialist agents — scraping, design, WordPress and React builds, QA — from intake to deployed build. Two decades of hand-coding craft paired with modern AI engineering, with deterministic QA gates so AI-generated work is verified, not just trusted.
services.forWho: Clients who want the speed of AI-assisted development without giving up pixel-accurate, verified output.
bullets: Orchestrate 8+ specialist AI agents (scraping, design, WordPress & React builds, QA) from intake to deployed build.
Engineered deterministic QA gates for AI-generated builds: pixel-diff visual parity (≥98% per breakpoint), scripted content-fidelity diffs, and computed-style verification of animations and effects.
Built an exact site-cloning pipeline that captures rendered HTML, CSS, assets, and motion from any platform (Squarespace, Elementor, Divi) and reproduces it as a native WordPress block theme.
Integrated the AI pipeline with production systems via MCP — Playwright, Google Ads/GA4, Drive, Figma, and Clarity.
Also shipped AI agents for SEO and PPC operations — a multi-agent SEO analysis suite and an industry-agnostic Google Ads negative-keyword auditor.
